set(TEST_LIBRARIES fez)
set(TEST_TARGET unit_tests)

file(COPY meshes/cylinder.msh DESTINATION "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}")

deal_ii_pickup_tests()

# Compile this template before its reference .output is generated by the user.
# No test is executed as a build dependency.
add_executable(unit_tests.quasi_incompressible_profile_correction
               quasi_incompressible_profile_correction.cc)
target_link_libraries(unit_tests.quasi_incompressible_profile_correction fez)
deal_ii_setup_target(unit_tests.quasi_incompressible_profile_correction)
